Services

Everything your pet needs, under one roof

From a routine booster to overnight critical care — no referrals across town, no repeated paperwork.

General Checkup

Full physical exams with a written wellness plan after every visit.

Vaccination

Core and lifestyle vaccines, tracked with automatic due-date reminders.

Surgery

Soft tissue and orthopaedic procedures in a dedicated sterile theatre.

Emergency Care

Triage within minutes, any hour, with on-call critical care staff.

Laboratory

In-house bloodwork and cytology with same-visit results.

Dental Care

Scaling, polishing and extractions under monitored anaesthesia.

Why Paw-M

The standard of care you'd want for yourself

Everything here is built to remove guesswork — for you and for the clinician holding the chart.

  • Experienced veterinarians

    An average of 12 years in practice, with board certifications across five specialties.

  • Modern equipment

    Digital radiography, in-house diagnostics and monitored anaesthesia as standard.

  • Transparent pricing

    Written estimates before treatment begins. No line item you haven't approved.

  • Emergency services

    A staffed critical care team on the floor, not a redirected answering service.

  • Personalised treatment

    Care plans built around your pet's age and history — not a template.

  • Digital medical records

    Your pet's complete chart, available to you and any clinic you choose.

Our team

Clinicians who explain the whole picture

Every veterinarian here holds a specialty focus, and every chart is reviewed by two of them.
